# dlaqsy

> Scales a symmetric/Hermitian matrix, using scaling factors computed by spoequ.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dlaqsy from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dlaqsy';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dlaqsy( order, uplo, N, A, LDA, s, strideS, scond, amax, equed ) → Float64Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored. `'upper'`: Upper triangular `'lower'`: Lower triangular. |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The order of the matrix A. |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>max(N, 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · On entry, the symmetric matrix A. On exit, if `equed === 'yes'`, the equilibrated matrix: diag(S) \* A \* diag(S). |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |
| `s` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | The scale factors for A. |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | Stride length for `s` |
| `scond` | `number` | Ratio of the smallest S(i) to the largest S(i). |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix entry. |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) \* A \* diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, the symmetric matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading n by n upper triangular part of A contains the upper triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading n by n lower triangular part of A contains the lower triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced.

  On exit, if `EQUED = 'Y'`, the equilibrated matrix: $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.
- `s`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `A`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `TypeError` if a string argument is not a valid option

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dlaqsy.ndarray(
    uplo,
    N,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    s, strideS, offsetS,
    scond, amax,
    equed
) → Float64Array
```

Equilibrates a symmetric matrix A using the scaling factors in the vector S.

This sets A(i,j) = S(i) _ A(i,j) _ S(j) when the matrix is poorly scaled.

Returns the equilibration type:
- 'N' - no equilibration was needed
- 'Y' - equilibration was done

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>max(N, 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output N-by-N symmetric matrix |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of A |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of A |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index offset for A |
| `s` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Scaling factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | Stride for s |
| ↳ `offsetS` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index offset for s |
| `scond` | `number` | Ratio of smallest to largest scaling factor |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix element |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) \* A \* diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, the symmetric matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading n by n upper triangular part of A contains the upper triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading n by n lower triangular part of A contains the lower triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced.

  On exit, if `EQUED = 'Y'`, the equilibrated matrix: $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.
- `s`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `A`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid matrix triangle

</section>

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dlaqsy()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`DLAQSY`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/dlaqsy.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import discreteUniform from '@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform/lib/index.js';
import dlaqsy from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dlaqsy';

/** @type {{ dtype: 'float64' }} */
const opts = {
	'dtype': 'float64'
};
const N = 3;
const A = discreteUniform( N * N, -10, 10, opts );
const s = discreteUniform( N, -10, 10, opts );

// Using the standard interface:
const equed = [ '' ];
let out = dlaqsy( 'column-major', 'upper', N, A, N, s, 1, 1, 1, equed );
console.log( out, equed[ 0 ] );

// Using the ndarray interface:
out = dlaqsy.ndarray( 'upper', N, A, N, 1, 0, s, 1, 0, 1, 1, equed );
console.log( out, equed[ 0 ] );
```

</section>
